title: L,S,A,Q and N
formulas: Equations of motion: $v = u + at$, $s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2$, $v^2 = u^2 + 2as$.
Distance in the nth second: $s_n = u + \frac{a}{2}(2n - 1)$.
keyPoints: The three equations assume uniform acceleration only; use $s_n = u + a(2n-1)/2$ for 'nth second' questions instead of subtracting two sums.
